item.title: Readings shared September 28, 2026

item.description:
The readings shared in Mastodon on 28 September 2026 are:

  • Formalization of Harder-Narasimhan theory. ~ Yijun Yuan. #LeanProver #ITP #AI4Math

  • Formalization of Langlands’s first main lemma for local epsilon factors. ~ Fukuhiro Ueda. #LeanProver #ITP #AI4Math
  • Lean 4 formalization of Michael Spivak's "Calculus" (covering both the 3rd and 4th editions). ~ Jon-Erik G. Storm. #LeanProver #ITP #AI4Math
  • Visual Lean: An accessible interface for Lean 4 proofwriting. ~ Autumn Mapes. #LeanProver #ITP
  • A formalisation of a special case of the union-closed conjecture in Isabelle/HOL. ~ Angeliki Koutsoukou-Argyraki, Lawrence C. Paulson. #IsabelleHOL #ITP
  • A formalisation of a special case of the union-closed conjecture in Isabelle/HOL. ~ Angeliki Koutsoukou-Argyraki, Lawrence C. Paulson. #IsabelleHOL #ITP

  • Verifying numerical methods with Isabelle/HOL. ~ Dustin Bryant, Jonathan Julian Huerta y Munive, Simon Foster. #IsabelleHOL #ITP #Math
